briefs.title: Realism Check: This Olive Tree Looks Like a Real One
briefs.objective: Demonstrate the tree’s realistic appearance and maintenance-free nature through side-by-side comparison with a real tree.
briefs.target_customer: Homeowners, apartment residents, busy professionals who want realistic home decor without upkeep.

scene_plan.visual: Close-up of olive leaf texture — natural lighting.
scene_plan.action: Focus on leaf detail — no movement.
scene_plan.text_overlay: This is the only one that looks real.

scene_plan.visual: Product shot — hykolity artificial olive tree on neutral background.
Split-screen — left: real olive tree, right: hykolity tree.
scene_plan.action: No movement — focus on visual comparison.

scene_plan.visual: CTA shot — product on shelf with ‘Only 5 left’ + ‘Tap to Shop’.

scene_plan.text_overlay: Realistic. No maintenance. Tap to Shop.

production_notes: Use natural lighting for real vs. fake comparison.
Ensure real tree is authentic — not staged.
Avoid any mention of Costco or other brands.
No fake scarcity — use ‘Only 5 left’ for urgency.
All text overlays must be clear, bold, and legible.

briefs.title: Transform Your Empty Corner in 30 Seconds
briefs.objective: Show how the tree instantly transforms an empty space into a stylish, lived-in area.
briefs.target_customer: Apartment residents, busy professionals, people who want easy home upgrades.

scene_plan.visual: Before shot — empty corner with ‘This space? Boring.’ text.
Product shot — ‘Perfect for small space’ + ‘No watering’.
scene_plan.text_overlay: Perfect for small space. No watering.

production_notes: Use quick cuts and dynamic camera movement.
Ensure 360° spin is smooth and visually engaging.
Avoid any mention of ‘Limited stock’ — use ‘Only 5 left’ for urgency.
All shots must be executable — no CGI or fake elements.

briefs.title: No Watering? No Problem. This Tree Fixes It.
briefs.objective: Show the tree as a stress-free, maintenance-free solution for busy lifestyles.
briefs.target_customer: Busy professionals, apartment residents, people tired of plant care.

scene_plan.visual: User holding phone — ‘I’m tired of watering plants.’

production_notes: Use natural lighting and authentic user reactions.
Ensure user is smiling and relaxed to trigger emotional relief.
Avoid any mention of ‘Limited stock’ — use ‘Only 5 left’ for urgency.
All text overlays must be clear, bold, and legible.
